capability_statement: AOF can record whether an external operator understood, reproduced, rejected, or was confused by a provider observation replay and route weak feedback into product governance.
before_state: Provider observation replay was human-readable, but operator comprehension and reproduction feedback lived outside runtime governance.
after_state: Operator comprehension, questions, confusing points, reproduction result, and governance route are schema-validated release evidence.
scenario: A reviewer asks whether the v11.5 replay is actually usable; inspect EOF-TASK-137-V116 to see the operator result and governance route.
five_minute_demo: Run external-operator-feedback-audit and open EOF-TASK-137-V116.json; confirm understanding_result, reproduction_result, blocked_or_confusing_points, governance_route, and not_proven.
time_saved_or_work_reduced: Reduces ambiguous post-release review by making operator comprehension a first-class audit target.
cognitive_load_removed: The operator no longer has to infer whether feedback is accepted, blocked, or routed to product review.

capability_matrix.user_value: understand whether provider replay evidence was actually usable by an operator

not_proven: This does not prove broad adoption, market value, semantic truth, provider correctness, production automation safety, credential safety, GitHub write safety, or productivity improvement.
